summary.name: Uizard
summary.one_liner: Uizard is an AI-assisted UI design tool that generates editable app, website, and desktop screen mockups from text prompts, screenshots, or hand-drawn wireframes.
use_cases: Generating multi-screen app or website prototypes from a text prompt
Turning screenshots or hand-drawn sketches into editable mockups
Quickly visualising ideas for stakeholders or clients
Running design sprints and brainstorming UI flows
Restyling an existing project with a generated theme
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Uizard as a tool for creating UI designs for apps, websites, and desktop software. Its AI features include Autodesigner, which generates multi-screen editable prototypes from simple text prompts and can modify or add screens to an existing project. Screenshot Scanner converts screenshots into editable mockups, and Wireframe Scanner turns hand-drawn sketches into digital designs. Generate Themes creates new visual styles for a project. The page also lists templates for mobile, web, tablet and web apps, plus a UI components library, and says teams can collaborate in real time.
notable: Autodesigner generates editable multi-screen prototypes from plain text prompts
Screenshot and hand-drawn wireframe scanners convert images into digital UI
caveats: The directory listing marks Uizard as paid, but the page itself does not state specific pricing tiers
Testimonials describe Autodesigner as being in Alpha at one point; current maturity is not confirmed on the page
